title: Distributed Variational Quantum Linear Solver
summary: The Variational Quantum Linear Solver (VQLS), a hybrid quantum-classical algorithm for solving linear systems, faces a practical scalability bottleneck: the Linear Combination of Unitaries (LCU) decomposition requires $O(L^2)$ circuit evaluations per optimizer iteration, where $L$ can grow to $4^n$ in the worst case for an $n$-qubit system. We address this computational bottleneck through two complementary strategies.
